title: The time length of the yellow triangle above the BG value should be greatly shortened
symptom: The yellow triangle appears above the BG value after changing the G6 transmitter and sensor, and lasts for about 30 or 36 hours due to a missing BG value. Users find this duration too long.
evidence_quote: The yellow triangle appeared after changing the G6 transmitter and sensor. Some say that the yellow triangle appears due to the missing value of BG and lasts for about 30 or 36 hours.
